verdict: Salesforce grew revenue 13% to $11.1B — helped by $444M from the Informatica acquisition — and a $558M paper gain on its investment stakes padded net income to $2.1B.

segments.name: Subscription and support
segments.note: The core software subscriptions — Sales, Service, Slack, Tableau, Agentforce and Data 360 — including $428M contributed by Informatica.

segments.name: Professional services and other
segments.note: Consulting and training that help customers roll the software out.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: The sales force and marketing — Salesforce's biggest running cost.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building the platform — including Agentforce, Salesforce's AI agents, and Data 360.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company — finance, legal and the back office.

opex.name: Restructuring
opex.note: Costs of Salesforce's restructuring program — mainly severance for eliminated roles.

otherDetail: A $558M paper gain on strategic investments (stakes Salesforce holds in other companies), plus $133M of other income, minus $317M of interest expense.

takeaways.title: Growth, with an acquisition assist
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 13% to a record $11.1B, but $444M of it came from Informatica, acquired in 2025 — roughly 4 points of the growth was bought, not organic.

takeaways.title: Agentforce is becoming real money
takeaways.text: Agentforce ARR passed $1.2B, up 205%, and combined AI and Data ARR reached $3.4B — the agent story is now a measurable slice of the business, not just a pitch.

takeaways.title: Profit per share jumped 52%
takeaways.text: GAAP EPS rose 52% to $2.42, helped by a $558M paper gain on investment stakes and a shrinking share count after heavy buybacks.

oneTimers: A $558M gain on strategic investments — paper gains on stakes Salesforce holds in other companies; it added $0.49 to diluted EPS.
Revenue includes $444M from Informatica, acquired in late 2025 — roughly 4 points of the 13% growth is the acquisition, not organic growth.
